name: Franklin University Switzerland
summary: US-style liberal arts university in Lugano, teaching in English; you apply to its bachelor of arts and choose a major as you go.

ib.text: Admission rests on your school record, a personal statement and one evaluation letter; the IB can earn advanced-standing credit. Non-English-medium applicants need TOEFL 90, IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 110.

apply.via: Franklin online application or the Common App

dates.label: Early Action and priority deadline; fee waived (same date every year)
Early Action decisions (same date every year)
Regular deadline if you need a visa (same date every year)
CHF 500 enrolment deposit due if admitted (same date every year)
Regular deadline if you need no visa, e.g. EU/EFTA (same date every year)

programmes.name: Health Sciences
programmes.about: Biology, chemistry, psychology and public health in one degree, covering the standard pre-med coursework US and Canadian medical schools ask for, with Academic Travel built into every semester.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects or points are set. IB HL and SL subjects at 5, 6 or 7 can earn advanced-standing credit.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission on your school record, a personal statement and one evaluation letter; you apply to the Bachelor of Arts, not the major. SAT/ACT are optional.

flagshipSource.title: Health Sciences major: pre-med coursework, students from over 50 countries, Academic Travel each semester

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Core courses in political science, sociology and history, plus languages, cultural studies, economics or communications, to analyse global issues for careers in diplomacy, international organizations, business, journalism or law.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects or points are set. IB HL and SL subjects at 5, 6 or 7 can earn advanced-standing credit.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission on your school record, a personal statement and one evaluation letter; you apply to the Bachelor of Arts, not the major. SAT/ACT are optional.

flagshipSource.title: Majors page: names international relations among the fields its interdisciplinary majors cover

programmes.name: Environmental Sciences and Studies
programmes.about: Two routes: a BS rooted in ecology, biology, chemistry, physics and field work, or a BA that links environmental science with social sciences and humanities. Both can include a School for Field Studies semester.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects or points are set. IB HL and SL subjects at 5, 6 or 7 can earn advanced-standing credit; 30 US credits of it allow a 3-year degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission on your school record, a personal statement and one evaluation letter; you apply to the Bachelor of Arts, not the major. SAT/ACT are optional.

flagshipSource.title: Majors page: environmental studies among the fields its interdisciplinary, experiential majors cover

notes: Admission is rolling, and for applicants who need no visa it can continue to mid-August if places remain.
Applying by 1 December may bring a USD 1,000 reduction in costs, depending on residency and enrolment type.
You can defer an offer by a year, or start in the spring term, by asking with your deposit.
